records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Union Partners!
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Glad to have Union Partners on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Union Partners* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone, zero tickets, and no reply to either outreach (email:fc1f4990, email:5010f7fa). Silent, fully inactive accounts rarely self-start; Pro/active status gives some upside within the 8 remaining days.

draft.subject: A hand getting your first Wrenfield project up
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Following up on my last note. Nothing's moved on the Union Partners account yet, so I thought I'd make it easier rather than just check in again.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is the step that makes everything else fall into place. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd rather do it solo.

Would a short call this week work? I'll walk through setting up that first project with you on your own work.

Best,
Nadia
